blind.description: A wooden trestle table covered with a draped deep purple tablecloth with gold-trimmed hems, functioning as a merchant or curio display. Arranged across the tabletop are various magical and scholarly oddities: a golden or bronze orb on a three-legged stand, an animal skull with curved horns, clusters of magenta and green crystal formations, two rolled parchment scrolls with brass caps, a carved wooden mask, a small banded treasure chest, and an intricate brass armillary sphere on a pedestal. All surfaces are cleanly modeled in a stylized, hand-painted video game art style with solid geometry and clean textures.
blind.from_above: A purple rectangular surface packed with objects: an orb on a stand at the left, a horned skull at top-center flanked by clusters of pink and green crystals, two scrolls at the bottom-left, a wooden face mask in the bottom-center, a small banded chest at bottom-right, and a brass armillary sphere on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: The table surface is about waist-high (around 2.5 ft), with the tallest items reaching about 3.5 ft (roughly 60% of the figure's height); the table width is around 4.5 to 5 ft.
